text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My debut race was so freakin' hype!! I 
should've just run with everything I had, 
but now I wanna run even harder than 
before!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And the very next day, Trainer suggested 
that I go on a training journey during the 
Junior tier!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
First, don't rush, gain real race 
experience, and pinpoint the stage where I 
can be the strongest!!
